meta.name: Police on Trial
meta.description: The murder of George Floyd by police officer Derek Chauvin on May 25, 2020, was arguably a pivotal event in the history of race and policing in the United States.Police on Trialshows, Chauvinâs encounter with Floyd was not the first time the Minneapolis police officer used excessive force on a Black citizen. Nor was it the first time that questions were raised around the culture of the Minneapolis Police Department itself. The film draws on reporting from the Minneapolis Star Tribune, and features never-before-published police cam video of Derek Chauvin using excessive force years before George Floydâs death, to document the trial and murder-conviction of Chauvin, and the various responses for police accountability and reform in Minneapolis.
